question: What is the meaning of mass fraction of pre-consumer recycled materials out of the total product mass in relation to recycled materials?
data_point: mass fraction of pre-consumer recycled materials out of the total product mass
description: The mass fraction of pre-consumer recycled materials out of the total product mass refers to the proportion, by mass, of recycled materials derived from waste materials diverted from the manufacturing process before reaching the consumer stage.
